data.gender_notes: Kashanun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘kashan’ meaning river, and ‘un’ meaning calmness. It represents the tranquility and stillness of a river. The name Kashanun carries the meaning “River Calmness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Kashanun usually hope their child will grow to embody river calmness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
